adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used for rhythmic clapping, holding sticks for martial segments, or feminine gesturing in cross-dressed roles.
movement_profile.footwork: Circular rhythmic steps in Vattakali; martial steps and stick-fight movements in specific Purattu.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular dancing along the periphery of a square pandal around a central lamp.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes martial movements which may involve changes in level; jumps not explicitly described.
movement_profile.partnering: Group circular formation; some Purattu involve pairs (e.g., husband and wife characters).
movement_profile.posture: Varies from upright and rhythmic to the crouched or aggressive stances of martial tribes.

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic circular dance performed by the community at the start of the night.
signature_moves.name: Vattakali

signature_moves.description: Farcical theatrical sketches depicting different castes with distinct movement styles.
signature_moves.name: Purattu

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Shifts from steady rhythmic pulses to fast-paced martial intensity.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid breaking the circular flow during Vattakali; ensure cross-dressed portrayals follow traditional stylistic cues.

music_profile.musical_form: Vattakali followed by multiple one-hour Purattu sketches
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic and circular for Vattakali; varied for Purattu
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the percussive drive of the Chenda and Maddalam drums, punctuated by the sharp clanging of Elatalam cymbals and the resonance of the Chengalam gong. The vocalizations transition from rhythmic chants in the circular dance to dramatic, character-driven dialogue and songs in the farcical segments.
music_profile.vocal_style: Singing in Malayalam and Tamil-influenced dialects

basic_steps: Gather in a circle around the central lamp of the pandal
Execute the rhythmic circular steps of the Vattakali in unison
Transition into the specific character movements of a Purattu sketch
Incorporate martial stick-fighting gestures for warrior-themed segments
Adopt stylized feminine gestures and speech if performing a female role
teaching.formation: Circular movement along the periphery of a square nine-pillared stage.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina for all-night performance and versatility in acting for the farce segments.
teaching.rhythm: Varies by segment; Vattakali is highly rhythmic while Purattu tempos change based on the caste depicted.
